Do you truly love God?

Are you willing to seek Him in truth and in spirit, not because of social media validation, not because you want people to applaud you, and not because you want to be known as someone who knows God?

Because the truth is, you can deceive everybody, but you can never deceive your Maker.

Sometimes, we become distracted.

We pray today, and tomorrow we run somewhere else
